FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DOCUMENT. Every compound, group and number in this text is invented for software testing.

Champion efficiency of PV-7 single-junction cells

Abstract: Opaque PV-7 cells with a gold back contact reached a power conversion efficiency of 21.4% under AM1.5G illumination at 25 °C, measured with a calibrated mask of 0.09 cm2.

Conditions: reverse scan, stabilised output over 60 seconds.
